name: EPIC 220521470
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 12.6 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220521470 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.554357 (16th-84th percentiles 12.100714-13.147443), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220521470: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4485.9277 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

text.card: A red giant 1,659 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.91 solar masses and 12.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,486 K at its surface.
